title: Glenn Gaffney blocked transfer of NHI material to Bigelow

tellings.quote: Now you have all this congressional testimony that he specifically, you know, blocked >> this, uh, you know, moving of exotic, you know, non-human origin technology that was under locked, uh, that was supposed to go to Bigalow Aerospace in 2008.

plain: In 2008 an official named Glenn Gaffney is said to have blocked the handover of technology of 'non-human origin' to Bigelow Aerospace, a private space company. Michels says that 'all this congressional testimony' names Gaffney as the person who stopped the move, and he credits a report listed as the 'Historical Report, volume one'. If true, it would mean the government holds such technology and that officials fight over who controls it.
